callback.title: Request a call back
callback.text: Leave your name and phone number — we will call you back during business hours, answer questions about lighting and prepare a preliminary estimate.
callback.privacy: By clicking the button you agree to the processing of your personal data for follow-up contact.
callback.phoneError: Enter the phone number in full, e.g. +7(999)000-00-00
callback.error: Could not send the request. Please try again a little later.
callback.successText: We will call the number you provided during business hours.

cookieConsent.title: Cookies and Yandex Metrika
cookieConsent.text: The site uses cookies to work properly and — only after you agree — Yandex Metrika with Webvisor, which records page views, clicks and actions on the page. Without your consent the counter sends nothing.
